loadError: The statements could not be loaded.
readyHelp: Performances and events that have ended. A statement fixes their sales and refunds at the time you issue it.
readyEmpty: Nothing is ready for a statement. Performances and events appear here once they have ended.
outOfDateLong: Out of date: sales or refunds changed after issue
notPayout: Statements record net sales. They are not invoices or payouts, and TicketBox charges no platform fee.
issuedEmpty: No statements have been issued yet.
downloadFailed: The file could not be downloaded.
confirmDescription: The statement is numbered and cannot be changed. It will print these details. A new revision can replace it later if sales or refunds change.
missingDetails: The legal name or tax code is missing. The statement will print the display name and mark them as not provided.
issueFailed: The statement could not be issued. Try again.
logoOmitted: The logo could not be loaded, so the statement was issued without it.
